name: Reflecting (Magic Armor or Shield Quality)
body:
Aura faint conjuration; CL 5th; Price +1 bonus; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

These armors and shields were created to protect against magical ranged attacks. Armor and shields mostly constructed of metal with this special quality apply their AC bonus to touch armor class vs rays.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Dodge
